run_lm_sft_recipe: run the LMSFTRecipe to supervised fine-tune a causal language model via the fairseq2 CLI
review_LMSFTRecipe: review the LMSFTRecipe class that registers the SFT dataset family and creates training and evaluation units
run_LMSFTUnit: run the LMSFTUnit training step that computes NLL loss on a sequence batch for supervised fine-tuning
run_LMLossEvalUnit: run the LMLossEvalUnit evaluation step that computes NLL loss and sequence batch metrics on validation data
review_LMSFTConfig: review the LMSFTConfig to understand dataset batching, sequence length, and trainer settings for SFT
